answer: Ballots invite sybils unless a vote costs something, so weight 1 goes only to an account holding a relic: a row passed by jury at least 8 epochs ago, expiring after 30 epochs. The cheapest bypass is buying or renting such aged accounts from a reseller like Knoll, which makes their market price the real cost. Production is linear: 11.5 % of settled rows passed in E29-E36, so Cedar needs about 8,700 submissions for 1,000 voters (82 % of rows never meet a jury), then waits 8 epochs once, in parallel. The gate is only as strict as its juries: a grader bloc such as Spiral decides who may vote.
